def test():
    """Test the LRU cache with TTL expiry."""
    from lru_cache import LRU, ttl_cache

    @ttl_cache(maxsize=100, ttl=10)
    def expensive(x):
        return x * 2

    assert expensive(5) == 10
    assert expensive(5) == 10  # cached
    assert expensive(6) == 12
    assert expensive(5) == 10  # still cached
